entities.summary: Sebastiano Dho was an Italian Roman Catholic bishop and prelate. He served as the Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Saluzzo, based in Saluzzo, from 1986 to 1993. He was then appointed Bishop of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Alba Pompeia from 3 July 1993, until his retirement on 28 June 2010.
